query: SELECT SUM(CAST(valor AS DECIMAL(14,2))) as total FROM lancamento_custo WHERE periodoCustoId = (SELECT id FROM periodo_custo WHERE mes = 4 AND ano = 2026 LIMIT 1) AND (observacoes LIKE '%QMD 0H48%' OR observacoes LIKE '%QMO6E54%' OR observacoes LIKE '%QMD0H48%' OR observacoes LIKE '%QMN1F10%' OR observacoes LIKE '%PERFURATRIZ HIDR%');
